A '''city''' on [[Ripoblus/Legends|Ripoblus]] served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Sacrifice" /> In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]] showed [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and [[Cha Niathal]] a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of Ripoblus's capital [[City/Legends|city]]. The hologram revealed explosions and smoking skylines, as the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] had resurrected their [[Sepan Civil War|dispute]] with the [[Dimok (people)|Dimoks]].<ref name="Sacrifice" />
